content_sections.heading: ICAR-IARI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the ICAR-IARI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download ICAR-IARI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Young Professional-II (YP-II) Okra Component: Post graduation degree in Horticulture (Vegetable Science)/ Genetics and Plant Breeding, Biotechnology/Molecular biology or other disciplines of Agricultural Sciences. Desirable: Work experience in vegetable breeding/ molecular biology techniques along with proficiency in computer application skills and the use of standard statistical packages. Young Professional-I (YP-I) Okra Component: Graduation degree in Agricultural Science or Diploma in Agricultural Sciences/Engineering/Technology and as per ICAR rule from a recognized university. Desirable: Working knowledge of computer and MS Office or Hands on experience of working on emasculation and pollination work, vegetable crop management.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for ICAR-IARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 21-09-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ICAR-IARI Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your application via email for the ICAR-IARI Young Professional recruitment is 21st September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies for the Young Professional posts at ICAR-IARI.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application process for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Interested candidates need to apply via email by sending their complete application with bio-data and self-attested documents before the last date.

faq.question: Q4. What is the minimum and maximum age limit for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 45 years for these positions.

faq.question: Q5. Are there any application fees for ICAR-IARI recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there are no application fees mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 30,000/- to Rs. 42,000/- per month, depending on the specific post (YP-I or YP-II).

faq.question: Q7. What are the educational qualifications required for the Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: Qualifications include Post graduation in specific agricultural sciences for YP-II and Graduation in Agricultural Science or Diploma for YP-I.

faq.question: Q8. When is the walk-in interview scheduled?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the selected candidates will be conducted on 29th September 2026.

faq.question: Q9. Does ICAR-IARI offer age relaxation for any categories?
faq.answer: Yes, age relaxation is provided: five years for SC/ST/Women and three years for OBC candidates.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be submitted with the application?
faq.answer: You need to attach self-attested copies of educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs.
